fusions.name: Skitter Cut
fusions.desc: Cuts every enemy within 2 tiles for 4 damage. For 2 seconds after, you move 12% faster.

fusions.name: Bounding Gore
fusions.desc: Bounds you to a target up to 7 tiles away and cuts it for 12 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Spring Clear
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles from where you stood, then increases your movement speed by 35% and your dodge chance by 10% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Startled Return
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
